narrativeProgression.description: Dillon Dong describes finding a rare event associated with a dwarf galaxy, similar to the Large Magellanic Cloud but located 500 million light years away.

He explains this event was incredibly luminous and initially thought to be a supernova or gamma-ray burst. Further investigation was needed as its luminosity would make it the most radio-luminous supernova ever observed.
